name: gokkan-keeper
description: Personal asset tracking service organized by purpose (granaries)

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter web dev & pnpm --filter api dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter api build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter shared typecheck && pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter api typecheck
scripts.setup: nvm install && nvm use && corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.7.0 --activate && pnpm install && pnpm --filter shared build
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/dist
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:browser && pnpm audit:dependencies
scripts.test:boundaries: pnpm --filter shared build && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter api test:boundaries
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter api test:integration
scripts.test:browser: pnpm --filter shared build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 playwright test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter shared build && c8 --all --src=apps/api/src --src=packages/shared/src --include="apps/api/src/auth/session.ts" --include="apps/api/src/services/alert-rules.ts" --include="apps/api/src/services/technical-indicators.ts" --include="apps/api/src/services/market-price.ts" --include="apps/api/src/services/yahoo-finance.ts" --include="apps/api/src/services/fsc-stock-price.ts" --include="apps/api/src/services/quote-cache.ts" --include="packages/shared/src/utils.ts" --check-coverage --lines=70 --branches=65 --functions=65 --reporter=text --reporter=lcov --reporter=html --reporter=json-summary --reports-dir=coverage/api pnpm --filter api exec node --import tsx --test scripts/checks/*.test.ts
